key_insight: MoI-Bench evaluates image generation and editing through the lens of mobile users’ needs. Its 64 subtasks and 1,150 samples provide a structured way to identify capability gaps between on-device and server-side models.
problem_solved: Existing benchmarks offer limited guidance for evaluating mobile image models against practical user needs, diverse tasks, and device resource constraints.
method: Ground the benchmark in mobile user needs for image generation and editing.
Define 16 operations, including removal and replacement, and eight visual target categories, including portraits and text.
Organize evaluation into 64 subtasks with 1,150 samples to help reveal model capability gaps.
impact: AI/ML practitioners can use MoI-Bench to identify weaknesses in mobile image models and prioritize improvements. It provides a user-centered framework for assessing progress toward practical on-device image tools.
visual_elements: Smartphone-versus-cloud diagram illustrating on-device and server-side model comparison.

paper_title: MoI-Bench: A Benchmark for Image Generation and Editing on Mobile Devices
paper_authors: Kailai Feng, Haoxiang Rao, Yuxiang Wei, Bo Chen, Junsong Li
